history.summary: Generic name - Ambala has many Shiv Mandirs; this entry documents the most written-about one: the ancient Shiva temple near Rambagh Ground in Old Town, Ambala, profiled by destinationsdesire.com (verify that the CSV intends this shrine rather than the Justdial-listed 'Shiv Mandir, New Model Town' or 'Shiv Mandir, Manav Chowk'). The profile says sages and saints chose the spot for meditation and installed a Shivling when the area was dense forest; it dates the temple's establishment to 1894 yet also calls it 'more than 500 years old' (internal conflict - verify). Local legend: Baba Kishanpuri Ji Maharaj meditated here and took samadhi at this spot; the priest Suresh Kumar Shastri is quoted as having served here 40 years and says reciting the Shiva Chalisa fulfils wishes. The main entrance is said to be adorned with tiles imported from China; large gatherings occur at Shivratri, Sawan and every major festival. Coordinates are for the geocoder's 'Shiv Mandir, Bans Bazar, Old Town' POI match (30.38192, 76.77191) - approximate, verify on site.
